question: A batch contains 600 parts to be processed. If x parts are processed each day and y days are needed, then \(y=600/x\). How many days are needed when 40 parts are processed each day?
solution: The total quantity is fixed, so \(y=600/x\). When \(x=40\), \(y=600\div40=15\) days.
